homePage.title: Compassionate, Confidential Mental Health Care — <highlight>100% Online</highlight> Across Morocco
homePage.description: Speak with accredited Moroccan psychologists from Casablanca, Rabat, Marrakech, Tangier, or anywhere in the Kingdom. No travel, zero stigma, and zero waiting rooms. Experience private, encrypted audio and video sessions in the comfort of your personal space.
homePage.languages: Available in Moroccan Darija, English & Arabic
homePage.imageAlt: Woman in a video therapy session on her laptop outdoors

howItWorks.title: How Remote Care Works on NafsCare
howItWorks.description: Accessing professional mental health support shouldn't feel complicated or exposed. Begin your journey in three guided steps from home.
howItWorks.step1Description: Complete a short, 100% confidential intake questionnaire regarding your current feelings, preferences, and personal goals. Prefer not to? You can easily skip straight to browsing.
howItWorks.step2Description: Receive smart matches with licensed counselors who specialize in your specific challenges and speak your preferred dialect (Moroccan Darija, French, English, or Standard Arabic).
howItWorks.step3Description: Attend high-definition encrypted video, audio, or continuous messaging sessions right from your phone, tablet, or laptop. No clinic visits, no awkward waiting areas.
howItWorks.quizPrompt: Not sure which therapy modality suits you best (CBT, Systemic, Psychoanalytic)? Our matching quiz clarifies it instantly.

benefits.title: Why Online Therapy is Redefining Wellness in Morocco
benefits.description: Breaking traditional barriers so you can focus entirely on healing and self-discovery.
benefits.benefit1Description: No bumping into neighbors, colleagues, or relatives in clinic lobbies. Attend sessions from the total privacy and security of your own bedroom or study.
benefits.benefit2Description: Skip hours battling Casa boulevard traffic or parking congestion. Whether you are in Agadir, Oujda, or a peaceful coastal village, quality care is just one click away.
benefits.benefit3Description: Book sessions that seamlessly fit your real life: 8:00 PM evening appointments after family dinners or quiet Sunday morning discussions.
benefits.benefit4Description: No need to explain Moroccan family dynamics, social obligations, or cultural nuances. Our specialists are deeply rooted in Moroccan society and traditions.
